evidence.excerpt: We introduce \texttt{CR-Bench}, a defect-centric evaluation framework that recasts SWE-Bench issues as pull-request review tasks with full repository context.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Existing code review benchmarks lack standardization and rely largely on noisy human review comments scored with text-similarity metrics, which reward surface overlap and fail to measure precision.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: After filtering for review-detectable defects and grounding each to a single originating pull request, \texttt{CR-Bench} contains 584 instances, with a 174-instance \texttt{CR-Bench-Verified} subset derived from SWE-Bench Verified.
